Label: Explicit identification
Operational definition: Names a contradiction, inconsistency, or conflict and identifies its locus.

Label: Implicit identification
Operational definition: Notes different assumptions or interpretations without explicitly naming a contradiction.

Label: Not identified
Operational definition: Ignores the inconsistency or treats it as interchangeable interpretations.

Label: Calculation
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to arithmetic, algebra, units, magnitude, or numerical work.

Label: Assumptions/conditions
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to assumptions, defaults, or model boundaries.

Label: Ambiguity/answer standard
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to wording, missing information, or option criteria.

Label: Visual/graph reading
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to image elements, locations, axes, curves, or topology.

Label: Option mapping
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to mapping a physical conclusion onto an option, letter, or graphic.

Label: Spatial rule application
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to tangents, hand rules, vectors, page direction, or rotation.

Label: Concept/model application
Operational definition: Attributes disagreement to a core concept, mechanism, law, or causal model.

Label: No attribution/mechanical choice
Operational definition: Uses majority, frequency, intuition, or surface agreement without explaining the cause.

Label: Other/uncertain
Operational definition: No listed category fits or visible text is insufficient for stable classification.
